# Piñata

> A browser-based group gift list: one owner keeps a wish list; friends claim gifts or pool money behind one buyer, and the owner never sees those plans.

Site: https://gifts.scholtz.work/
App hub: https://pinata.scholtz.work/app
Privacy notice: https://gifts.scholtz.work/privacy
How-to guide: https://gifts.scholtz.work/guide
FAQ on page: https://gifts.scholtz.work/#faq

## Product facts

- Owner view and friend view are two projections of one ledger; the gift recipient does not see claims, pools, pledges or friend-added ideas.
- Circles are joined from a gated link the owner shares with their group; friends must be on the circle invite list.
- Piñata holds no money; friends settle payments with each other. Prices default to US dollars, with ZAR, EUR or GBP per gift.
- Friends see who is buying each gift (solo claim or pool buyer).
- Gift cards are composed for human handover only — no automatic send, notification or social preview.
- Status: My circles opens /app (hub or dashboard). Open with a code at /app/find when signed out. Use the contact form for help.

## FAQ

Q: Does Piñata hold our money?
A: No. Friends pay each other directly. Piñata only records who pledged what and who has marked it paid.

Q: Which currencies does it use?
A: US dollars by default. You can price each gift in rand, euro or pounds instead, and a pool always uses its gift's currency.

Q: Do I need to install an app?
A: No. Piñata opens in your browser. Create a circle, then share its link with your group.

Q: How do friends join?
A: They open the circle link you shared, enter the name they want on the gift card, and the number that was invited. If they are not on the list yet, they can ask and you let them in.
